title: Prove sessions outside any project in a serving release
text: Source and focused tests cover organization-scoped registration through Claude, Codex and Cursor hooks, immutable scope, folder admission refusals, organization-owned messages, relay jobs, background worker launches from a home steering seat, and roster, history, board and machine visibility. The release still owes the scripted installer-campaign cases for an agent outside a project on each declared harness, reinstallation, and first project-work refusal and recovery, plus the Command and Browser scenarios, against the exact candidate in local, self-host and hosted modes. This is a delivery obligation of the current change, not deferred implementation.
